paras.en: And now, of course, six years have already passed... I have never told this story before. The friends who saw me again were very glad to see me alive. I was sad, but I would tell them: “I’m tired, that’s all...”
paras.zh: 而现在，当然，已经过去六年了……我还从来没有讲过这个故事。那些又见到我的伙伴，看见我还活着，都十分高兴。我很难过，却对他们说：“是累的……”

paras.en: Now I have found a little comfort. That is... not quite. But I know he has returned to his planet, because at daybreak I could not find his body. It was not such a heavy body... And at night I love listening to the stars. It is like five hundred million little bells...
paras.zh: 现在，我多少得到了一点安慰。也就是说……还不完全。但我很清楚，他已经回到了自己的星球，因为天亮时，我没有找到他的身体。那并不是多么沉重的身体……而我喜欢在夜里听星星。那就像五亿个小铃铛……

paras.en: But now something extraordinary is happening. I forgot to add the leather strap to the muzzle I drew for the little prince! He can never have been able to fasten it onto the sheep. So I wonder: “What has happened on his planet? Perhaps the sheep has eaten the flower...”
paras.zh: 可是，现在却发生了一件不同寻常的事。我给小王子画的嘴套，竟忘了添上皮带！他一定始终没能把它系在绵羊嘴上。于是我问自己：“他的星球上发生了什么？也许绵羊已经把花吃掉了……”

paras.en: Sometimes I tell myself: “Surely not! The little prince shuts his flower under her glass globe every night, and he keeps a close watch on his sheep...” Then I am happy. And all the stars laugh softly.
paras.zh: 有时我对自己说：“一定没有！小王子每天晚上都把他的花关在玻璃罩里，还仔细看着他的绵羊……”于是我就快乐起来。所有的星星都轻轻地笑着。

paras.en: Sometimes I tell myself: “We all let our attention wander now and then, and once is enough! One evening he forgot the glass globe, or else the sheep went out without a sound during the night...” Then all the little bells turn into tears!...
paras.zh: 有时我又对自己说：“人总有走神的时候，一次就够了！有一天晚上，他忘了玻璃罩，或者绵羊在夜里悄无声息地走了出来……”于是，小铃铛全都变成了眼泪！……

paras.en: That is a very great mystery. For you who love the little prince too, as for me, nothing in the universe is the same depending on whether or not, somewhere, we do not know where, a sheep we do not know has eaten a rose...
paras.zh: 这真是一个大大的谜。对同样爱着小王子的你们，也对我来说，在某个不知在哪里的地方，一只我们不认识的绵羊究竟有没有吃掉一朵玫瑰——答案不同，宇宙里就没有什么还是一样的了……

paras.en: Look at the sky. Ask yourself: “Has the sheep eaten the flower, yes or no?” And you will see how everything changes...
paras.zh: 看看天空吧。问问自己：“绵羊到底有没有吃掉那朵花？”你们就会看见，一切会变得多么不同……

paras.en: And no grown-up will ever understand that it matters so much!
paras.zh: 而大人们永远也不会明白，这件事竟然这样重要！

paras.en: To me, this is the most beautiful and the saddest landscape in the world. It is the same landscape as the one on the previous page, but I have drawn it once more so you can see it clearly. This is where the little prince appeared on earth, then disappeared.
paras.zh: 对我来说，这是世界上最美、也最悲伤的风景。这和前一页是同一处风景，可我又画了一次，好让你们看清楚。小王子就是在这里出现在地球上，又消失了。

paras.en: Look carefully at this landscape so you will be sure to recognise it if one day you travel to Africa, into the desert. And if you happen to pass that way, I beg you, do not hurry. Wait a little, right beneath the star! If a child then comes to you, if he laughs, if he has golden hair, if he does not answer when asked a question, you will surely guess who he is. Then be kind! Do not leave me so sad: write to me quickly to say he has come back...
paras.zh: 请仔细看看这片风景，好让你们有一天去非洲的沙漠旅行时，一定能认出它。而如果你们碰巧经过那里，我求求你们，别急着走，就在那颗星星的正下方等一会儿！如果这时有个孩子向你们走来，如果他笑着，如果他有一头金色的头发，如果别人问他话，他却不回答，你们一定能猜到他是谁。那么，请你们好心一点吧！别让我这么难过：快写信告诉我，他回来了……
